activity_summary: The morning rehearsal had no clothes in it. Heminges would not try the crown today. Garnish had you down for Egeon in the afternoon, opening and then idle. You said the voice was thick. You were to be heard at the back. The plot for tomorrow was not on the peg yet. You did not give Love's Labour's Won a new answer before the call.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the thick voice, and did not move the other play.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Kept the apparel for tomorrow, and asked to be heard at the back.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Set Egeon for the afternoon, and would not hang tomorrow's plot early.

entities.name: The Comedy of Errors
entities.context: Mentioned in No clothes this morning

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: No clothes this morning. The apparel is tomorrow

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The voice is thick. I am not pretending otherwise.

quotes.speaker: abel_garnish
quotes.text: Egeon this afternoon, and he opens, and then he waits.
